venue: Half pitch (full pitch for final game)
theme: Pressing from the front & winning the ball high
focus: Out of possession: forward press, cutting passing lanes, transition to attack
objectives: Front line press as a unit and show the ball one way
Midfield step up to intercept the pass into the press trap
Transition quickly to goal within 5 seconds of a turnover
key_messages: "Show inside / show out" - agree the side

blocks.title: Rondo 5v2 with press triggers

diagram.caption: Two grids running side by side. 5 attackers keep the ball, 2 defenders press in pairs.

blocks.setup: 15x15m grid per group of 7. 5 on the outside, 2 pressers in the middle. Change pressers every 60 seconds or on a win.
how: Attackers one-touch or two-touch round the square.
First defender presses the ball carrier, second defender cuts the next pass.
Pressers win the ball = swap with the player who lost it.
blocks.link_to_theme: Introduces the pressing pair: 1st presser shows, 2nd presser reads and intercepts.
coaching_points: Press on the bent run, showing the ball carrier one way
2nd defender reads the hips of the passer
Low body position, stick on the ground on the open side

step.space: Shrink to 12x12 to speed up decisions

blocks.title: Pressing unit walkthrough: 3 forwards vs back 4

diagram.caption: Back 4 (red) build out from a coach feed. Front 3 (blue) set the press and show the ball inside.

blocks.setup: Half pitch. Back 4 + GK in red, front 3 in blue. Coach feeds into any red defender. Yellow-coned trap zone on the left side.
how: Walk it through first at 50% pace, then 75%, then full.
On the feed, CF curves to show the ball towards the trap side.
Far-side forward tucks in to cut the switch; near forward closes the outlet.
Defenders try to play out past the forwards through the cone gates on the halfway line.
blocks.link_to_theme: Builds the shape and trigger cues that the rest of the session relies on.
coaching_points: Trigger = a slow pass, a poor touch, or a pass to the full-back
Curved approach so you cut off one side
Distances: forwards no more than 10-12m apart so no pass splits them
Talk: CF calls 'Trap!' when the ball goes into the zone
questions: Where do we want the ball to go?
What tells you it's time to press?
progressions: Add a defensive mid for the reds to find
Live: reds score by dribbling over halfway

blocks.title: 6v4 + GK: win it high, score in 5 seconds

diagram.caption: Blue (6) press red (4 + GK) in their own half. Win it and score in the full goal within 5 seconds.

blocks.setup: Half pitch. 4 red defenders + GK defend the full goal and attack 2 mini goals on the halfway line. 6 blue press. Rotate groups every 4 minutes.
how: Every rep starts with the GK playing out to a red defender.
Blue win the ball: 5-second countdown to get a shot away.
Red get past the press: score in either mini goal.
blocks.link_to_theme: Puts the pressing shape under live pressure and adds the transition reward.
coaching_points: Press as a unit, not as individuals
Midfielders step up when the ball is trapped - don't sit off
On a turnover: first look is forward, play early
progressions: Red get a free 'out' player on the halfway line
regressions: Red must play out through the trap side
blocks.activity_notes: Run two waves: next group waits at the 23 on the cones and goes as soon as a rep ends. Rest time = one rep.

blocks.title: 8v8 + GKs: press-zone scoring

diagram.caption: 8v8 between the 23m lines plus Ds. A goal from a ball won in the attacking 23 counts double.

blocks.setup: Full pitch, 8v8 plus GKs. Two spare players rotate in every 3 minutes.
how: Normal hockey rules, no long aerials.
Ball won in your attacking 23 and scored = 2 goals.
Coach restarts quickly from the back with a feed to keep tempo high.
blocks.link_to_theme: Rewards the exact behaviour we want: win it high and finish quickly.
coaching_points: Recognise the triggers in a live game
Recover shape quickly if the press is broken
Communication - one voice calls the press
progressions: Reds must play out from GK every restart
regressions: Add a neutral floater who plays for the team in possession

blocks.title: 11v11 (or numbers available) - apply the press
blocks.setup: Full pitch match. Swap bibs at half-time. Coach stops play only to freeze a good or missed press trigger.
how: Each team gets a 'press captain' who calls the trap.
Track turnovers won in the attacking half on a whiteboard.
coaching_points: Look for the triggers we practised
Celebrate the turnover, not only the goal
questions: How many turnovers did we win high? What made them work?

safety: Shin guards and gum shields for all
Check the pitch surface and goals before starting
